versions.changelog:
fluora-setup 1.2.1

- Reduced minimum recommended wallet funding from $5–10 USDC to $1 USDC throughout documentation and next steps.
- Updated cost summary and best practices sections to reflect new minimum.
- Added/modified guidance text in return values and after-setup instructions for lower funding requirements.
- Added _meta.json file for improved metadata management.
Removed all gas/ETH mentions - payments are now handled automatically with USDC only
Updated to use GitHub repo instead of npm. Fixes useService parameter parsing bug. Includes local build configuration.
Update gas fees: clarify service provider pays gas costs ($0 for users)
Update recommended funding amount from $5-10 to $1 for testing

Initial release of Fluora Setup – an interactive onboarding wizard for the Fluora marketplace.

- Installs and verifies the fluora-mcp global npm package.
- Generates a wallet and stores the private key in ~/.fluora/wallets.json.
- Extracts/outputs the wallet address and guides through funding on Base (L2).
- Configures mcporter with the Fluora registry.
- Checks and verifies each setup step for completeness.
- Provides clear instructions for troubleshooting, security, and next steps.
